name: agent-socket-monorepo
description: A relay that lets any web app expose itself to AI chats via a paste-able URL.

scripts.check: npm run check -w relay && npm run check -w sdk && npm run check -w registry
scripts.build: npm run build -w sdk && bash chrome-extension/scripts/vendor-sdk.sh
scripts.harness: npm run build -w sdk && node harness/run.mjs all
scripts.ext:test:unit: node chrome-extension/test/reconnect.unit.mjs && node chrome-extension/test/nav-guard.unit.mjs && node --test chrome-extension/test/profiles.unit.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm test -w sdk && npm test -w registry && npm run harness && npm run ext:test:unit
